name: Capucine
source:
[i]"Despite my unique attire, I am the hospital director as well as a doctor."[/i]

The director of the hospital where Nadia is admitted, and her personal doctor. His expression rarely changes, making it difficult for people to befriend him, but he is very caring toward his patients. He is the 7th minister of the "Society of Exorcists" who sees Relivers as evil, but he appears somewhat troubled by his followers' extreme behavior as of late.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Doctor, minister of the Society of Exorcists

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
